catalog.nvfp4Search: GPU ya Blackwell eraga nti erina memory emala. Londa enkyusa za NVFP4 singa ekizimbe ne yingini bizisobola. Source code erimu enkola ey’obutereevu ey’okutikka FLUX.2 Klein 4B mu Comfy. Nga tonnawanula, kebera CUDA PyTorch, ebitundu eby’okwesalirawo, model ezikozesebwa wamu ne memory eriwo. Okuzuula hardware tekukakasa nti enkola etekeddwawo ekola oba nti ejja kukola mangu.
catalog.nvfp4Prefer: NVFP4 etegeezeddwa ku GPU eno ne FLUX.2 famire ya Klein 4B. Okutikka enzaaliranwa kwetaaga ensengeka ya Comfy ewagirwa, CUDA PyTorch n'ebisinziirwako eby'okwesalirawo. Londa ekifaananyi ky'ekifaananyi, Qwen3 encoder ne VAE okwawukana mu Creation settings. Obudde bw'okudduka, okugatta okujjuvu n'okujjukira okw'obwereere bikyalina okukakasibwa.
catalog.nvfp4Check: NVFP4 ezuuliddwa: Obusobozi bwa GPU, okujjukira okw'obwereere, ensengeka y'obuzito oba obuyambi bw'enzimba tebukakasibwa. Kebera yingini ya CUDA nga tonnalonda nkyukakyuka eno. Enkola yokka teteekawo kukwatagana.
catalog.nvfp4Unsupported: Native NVFP4 tesemba ne GPU ezuuliddwa oba VRAM ey’obwereere eriwo kati. Lowooza ku GGUF quantization ekwatagana oba yingini y’okukwatagana. Ekkubo eryo teriwa native FP4 acceleration.
catalog.quantQualityAdvice: Obulagirizi bwa Novera GGUF ku bitundu by’ebiwandiiko, ebifaananyi ne vidiyo: Q6_K oba okusingawo y’entandikwa gye tuteeseddwa nga tukulembeza obwesigwa; Q4_K_M egerageranya omutindo n'okujjukira. Bino bye biteeso, so si kipimo kya butuufu ekya bonna. Ebivaamu bisinziira ku muze n’omulimu. NVFP4 n’enteekateeka endala ez’okugera quantization zeetaaga okukwatagana kwazo n’okukebera omutindo.
